name: Marble Priest
oracle_text:
All Walls able to block this creature do so.
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to this creature by Walls.
blocked_sentences: All Walls able to block this creature do so.
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to this creature by Walls.

needs.what: a static block requirement on the source attacker (509.1c): every creature matching a printed blocker filter (here subtypes: ["Wall"]) that is able to block this creature must do so -- Lure-style, narrowed by a `blockers` filter
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `must_block` op is a one-shot on resolution with no trigger to hang it on, and the only static that reads `blockers` is `block_restriction`, which restricts who MAY block (menace, Tromokratis' `require_all`) rather than requiring blocks; no static_effect imposes a block requirement

needs.what: a `prevent_damage` static (prevent_all, combat_only, affects self_only) narrowed by a filter on the damage SOURCE, so only combat damage dealt by Walls is prevented
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `damage_source` is accepted only on `replace_damage` (the loader refuses it on any other static), and `prevent_damage` with `combat_only` would prevent combat damage from every creature, which is a much stronger card
